description: Converting an unknown tuple to a set fails when an element's type doesn't convert to the set's
notes: Not disputed like native/functions/function-error-is-eval-error: the README defines convert's result as the conversion, and the spec makes this conversion an error, also for an unknown tuple, because the tuple's types already rule it out: its second element, a tuple, has no conversion to string (spec.md#unknown-values-and-the-dynamic-pseudo-type).
